description: Search works by free-text query, author, and/or title, with pagination.

q.description: Optional free-text query matched against title, author name, or subjects.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has numFound, start, numFoundExact, and docs.

description: Get a single work by its Open Library work id.

work_id.description: The Open Library work id (e.g. OL27448W).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the work document; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the editions of a work.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has links, size, and entries; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single author by their Open Library author id.

author_id.description: The Open Library author id (e.g. OL26320A).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the author document; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the works written by an author.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has size and entries; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a subject and the works tagged with it, ranked by edition count.

subject.description: The subject name or key (e.g. 'fantasy' or 'Science Fiction').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has key, name, subject_type, work_count, and works.

description: Look up an edition by its ISBN-13 or ISBN-10.

isbn.description: The ISBN (13 or 10 digit; hyphens are ignored).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the edition document; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
